description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/Listing/GetBulkHistory. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Returns recent bulk publication jobs and their recorded status/errors for the selected store. ownerAgent: publication. Use when: Use it to inspect bulk publication history and diagnose a job's recorded error. Input: Optional AutoListRequest. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. Output: Returns logs with job status, error code, listing status and origin. EnumValues maps the numeric codes. ChannelListingStatusFlags is a bitmask: decode every set bit, not the whole number as one ordinal. Search terms: listing getbulkhistory. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.
